credential.label: Mixpanel service account

guide.summary: US residency, service-account REST. Raw export, user activity, profiles, reports and event import.
guide.content:
# Mixpanel API usage

Service-account REST, us residency. Account purpose: Product reporting

Default project: 42.

- This connection uses Connecta's REST tools with a service account. Hosted MCP is the default `mixpanel()` mode; `via: "api"` explicitly selects REST. Declare two connection ids when both are useful. The operator pastes `username:secret` into the API connection, which sends ordinary HTTP Basic, unlike hosted MCP's `Bearer Basic` scheme. OAuth and static headers are refused in API mode.
- One connection stays in one residency region, across all projects the account can reach. US uses `mixpanel.com` for query/app, `data.mixpanel.com` for export and `api.mixpanel.com` for ingestion. EU uses `eu.mixpanel.com`, `data-eu.mixpanel.com` and `api-eu.mixpanel.com`. India uses `in.mixpanel.com`, `data-in.mixpanel.com` and `api-in.mixpanel.com`. Wrong residency can look like missing data; do not interpret an empty response without checking the project region.
- Start with `list_projects`, which returns redacted account metadata from `/api/app/me`. Its public reference does not specify the response schema. Resolve ids from that metadata or project settings, never guess one. Every project-scoped tool accepts `project_id`; an omitted id uses `defaultProjectId` when configured. An explicit id overrides that default and still requires service-account membership. Projects with Data Views may also require `workspace_id`, which the query and report tools accept; `export_events` and `import_events` do not.
- Use REST for raw event export, profile queries and individual event sequences. Use hosted MCP for schema discovery, business context, aggregate analytics and dashboard work. Discover exact event and property names there before filtering raw data.
- Export has no documented cursor. Begin with a short date range and an event or `where` filter. Every export returns `truncated` and a notice. A true flag means events may be missing at the byte or event cap; narrow ranges or filters, rather than inferring "no later event B" from a sample. Dates are inclusive. Mixpanel documents UTC for newer projects and the project timezone for older projects; check project settings around the January 2023 transition. Event timestamps default to seconds, or milliseconds with `time_in_ms`.
- `get_profile_activity` sorts a user's returned events by timestamp, but `/stream/query` is in maintenance mode and has no documented pagination/completeness guarantee. For absence or sequence claims use complete, filtered raw export and sort/reduce inside `execute_code`.
- `query_profiles` is a read-only POST to the Query API's `/engage`, distinct from ingestion `/engage` profile mutations. Pagination is vendor-owned: there is no documented caller `page_size`. Keep the same selector and output properties, pass the returned `session_id`, and increment `page` while `page.hasMore` is true. Do not treat `total` as the page length. `raw: true` preserves the redacted vendor envelope when needed.
- Saved Insights uses `bookmark_id` from a report URL. Saved Funnels uses `funnel_id`, discoverable with `mixpanel_api_read` on `/api/query/funnels/list`. The documented Retention endpoint takes events and date parameters, not a saved-report id; default/birth retention also requires `born_event`. Use hosted MCP for an existing saved Retention report; `query_retention` recomputes retention from events and dates. Reduce nested report results before returning them.
- Retention `interval` is capped at 90 only for `unit: "day"`, including the default when unit is omitted. Week and month intervals have no documented 90-unit cap. Both named and generic retention reads enforce the day limit.
- `mixpanel_api_search` and `mixpanel_api_details` inspect the reviewed operation subset locally. `mixpanel_api_read` permits GET only on those operations, with fixed residency hosts and no caller URL or headers. It cannot reach service-account administration, arbitrary app APIs, profile mutation, JQL or ingestion. Generic export retains the named export's byte/event bounds. Use named tools for Engage and import.
- `import_events` is an additive write and requires an Owner or Admin service account on the target project. Connecta enforces 2000 events, 10MB per batch, less than 1MB per event and Mixpanel's documented property limits. Supply stable `$insert_id` values and use strict validation. A 400 can still ingest the valid events; never retry a whole batch automatically. Inspect the target and failed records through a trusted operator workflow before deciding what to send again.
- Profile writes are deferred. The official ingestion `/engage` contract requires `$token` in each update; service-account Basic alone does not satisfy it, and the service-account reference documents no project-token retrieval operation. Profile delete and other irreversible mutations are absent.
- Query permits 60 queries per hour and 5 concurrent queries per project. Export permits 60 per hour, 3 per second and 100 concurrent queries. Ingestion permits 2GB uncompressed JSON per minute or about 30000 events per second. The API connection conservatively shares a 60-call/hour, 5-concurrent default across all tools and projects; it is a per-runtime approximation, not a distributed quota or a per-second export limiter. Operators may override `callAdmission`, especially for import-heavy deployments or multiple runtimes sharing an account. A vendor 429 still wins; respect `Retry-After`.
- Successful responses recursively redact credential-named properties and bearer URLs. Arbitrary analytics properties remain user data; do not put secrets into free-text event names or property values. HTTP failures expose status and recovery guidance rather than vendor text that could echo a credential.

tools.name: mixpanel_api_search
tools.description: Find Mixpanel API operations by keyword or path in the pinned API index. Returns method, path, and summary; reads no account data.

query.description: Keywords or a path, e.g. refund charge.

tools.name: mixpanel_api_details
tools.description: Read one Mixpanel API operation's request contract: path, query, and body parameters with types, enums, and required names. Reads no account data.

path.description: The path template from search, or a concrete path.

body.description: Body content type and schema; truncated: true marks unexpanded levels.

tools.name: mixpanel_api_read
tools.description: GET a reviewed Mixpanel operation on this region's hosts. No arbitrary URLs, profile updates or service-account administration.

path.description: Concrete path from search with ids filled in, e.g. /v1/customers/cus_123. No query string.

project_id.description: Project id from list_projects or project settings; omitted only with defaultProjectId.

query.description: Documented query parameters; use details to resolve required names. No auth headers or body.

select.description: Dot paths to keep from data, e.g. data.id; a path through a list applies to each item.

data.description: Response body: JSON, text, NDJSON rows, { contentType, bytes, base64 }, or HEAD's headers.

page.description: Present on lists: pass next as the param query parameter (a body field when in is body) for the next page. hasMore without next: no cursor exists.

path.description: GET this path for the next page, when it differs from this call's.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Read service-account identity and reachable project metadata. Project tokens and credentials are redacted.

page.description: When hasMore is true, repeat the same filters with the next page and session id.

tools.name: export_events
tools.description: Export bounded raw JSONL events for a date range. Truncation is explicit; narrow filters to establish absence.

project_id.description: Project id from list_projects or project settings; omitted only with defaultProjectId.

from_date.description: Inclusive date, YYYY-MM-DD. Export uses the vendor's project-age timezone rules.

to_date.description: Inclusive date, YYYY-MM-DD. Export uses the vendor's project-age timezone rules.

event.description: Optional event-name filter, encoded as JSON on the wire.

where.description: Mixpanel segmentation expression to filter events.

time_in_ms.description: Request millisecond timestamps instead of the default seconds.

limit.description: Mixpanel event cap is 100000; Connecta defaults to 1000.

max_bytes.description: Connecta's byte ceiling, default 65536 and maximum 1048576; partial trailing lines are discarded.

tools.name: get_profile_activity
tools.description: Read one user's events, ordered by timestamp. Mixpanel's activity endpoint is in maintenance mode; use export for complete analysis.

project_id.description: Project id from list_projects or project settings; omitted only with defaultProjectId.

workspace_id.description: Data view workspace id when the project requires one.

distinct_id.description: Exact distinct_id of the user whose event history to read.

from_date.description: Inclusive date, YYYY-MM-DD. Export uses the vendor's project-age timezone rules.

to_date.description: Inclusive date, YYYY-MM-DD. Export uses the vendor's project-age timezone rules.

raw.description: Return the redacted vendor envelope instead of the named tool's projection.

page.description: When hasMore is true, repeat the same filters with the next page and session id.

tools.name: query_profiles
tools.description: Query existing Engage profiles. This POST is read-only; continue with the returned session_id and next page, preserving filters.

project_id.description: Project id from list_projects or project settings; omitted only with defaultProjectId.

workspace_id.description: Data view workspace id when the project requires one.

session_id.description: Session from the previous response; repeat it unchanged.

page.description: Zero-based page; a nonzero page requires session_id.

raw.description: Return the redacted vendor envelope instead of the named tool's projection.

page.description: When hasMore is true, repeat the same filters with the next page and session id.

tools.name: get_insights_report
tools.description: Read a saved Insights report by bookmark_id from its report URL. The id is project-local.

project_id.description: Project id from list_projects or project settings; omitted only with defaultProjectId.

workspace_id.description: Data view workspace id when the project requires one.

bookmark_id.description: Saved Insights bookmark id from the report URL.

page.description: When hasMore is true, repeat the same filters with the next page and session id.

tools.name: get_funnel_report
tools.description: Read a saved funnel by funnel_id and date range. Use mixpanel_api_read on /api/query/funnels/list to resolve ids.

project_id.description: Project id from list_projects or project settings; omitted only with defaultProjectId.

workspace_id.description: Data view workspace id when the project requires one.

funnel_id.description: Saved funnel id from the vendor list or report URL.

from_date.description: Inclusive date, YYYY-MM-DD. Export uses the vendor's project-age timezone rules.

to_date.description: Inclusive date, YYYY-MM-DD. Export uses the vendor's project-age timezone rules.

page.description: When hasMore is true, repeat the same filters with the next page and session id.

tools.name: query_retention
tools.description: Query retention by events and date range. Mixpanel documents no saved Retention bookmark-id endpoint.

project_id.description: Project id from list_projects or project settings; omitted only with defaultProjectId.

workspace_id.description: Data view workspace id when the project requires one.

from_date.description: Inclusive date, YYYY-MM-DD. Export uses the vendor's project-age timezone rules.

to_date.description: Inclusive date, YYYY-MM-DD. Export uses the vendor's project-age timezone rules.

born_event.description: Initial event name for birth retention.

interval.description: Bucket interval; Mixpanel caps day intervals at 90.

interval_count.description: Number of buckets, in addition to the zeroth interval.

page.description: When hasMore is true, repeat the same filters with the next page and session id.

tools.name: import_events
tools.description: Import up to 2000 events and 10MB uncompressed JSON. Owner/Admin required; validation errors may still ingest valid events. Never replay automatically.

project_id.description: Project id from list_projects or project settings; omitted only with defaultProjectId.

events.description: Mixpanel event batch; supply stable insert ids for deduplication.

properties.description: Event properties with time (integer seconds/milliseconds), distinct_id (string) and stable $insert_id (1..36 alphanumeric/hyphen bytes). Fewer than 255 keys; nested depth 3.

page.description: When hasMore is true, repeat the same filters with the next page and session id.
